data.name: Hudaafah
data.gender_notes: Hudaafah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a guide or companion, often used in the context of the Prophet Muhammad and his companions. The name Hudaafah carries the meaning “Guide, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hudaafah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies guidance and companionship, both spiritually and in everyday life.
data.etymology: Hudaafah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hudaafah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: هدافة
in_arabic.long_meaning: هدافة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة الهداية، ويعني الارشاد والهداية إلى الطريق المستقيم، وقد وردت كلمة الهداية في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'اهدنا الصراط المستقيم'، ويعتبر اسم هدافة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات إسلامية عميقة.

in_urdu.name: هدافہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو ہدایت اور رہنمائی پر دلالت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: هدافہ ایک علم نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور ہدایت سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی کرنا یا کسی کو صحیح راستے پر چلانا، اسلامی تقالید میں ہدایت ایک اہم تصور ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن میں ذکر ہے: 'ہدنا الصراط المستقيم'، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: हदाफा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम मार्गदर्शन और नेतृत्व को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हदाफा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन या सही रास्ते पर चलने की प्रेरणा देना, इस्लामी परंपरा में हिदायत एक महत्वपूर्ण अवधारणा है, जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: 'اهدنا الصراط المستقيم'।

in_english.name: Hudaafah
in_english.meaning: Guidance or leading to the right path
in_english.long_meaning: Hudaafah is a female given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'hidayah,' which means guidance or leading someone to the right path. The concept of guidance is significant in Islam, as mentioned in the Quran: 'Guide us to the straight path.' This name holds spiritual significance and is associated with positive personality traits such as wisdom and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hudaafah" is of Arabic origin and holds significant historical importance in Islamic culture. It is the name of one of the earliest and most prominent companions of Prophet Muhammad, Abdullah ibn Umar Al-Hudeini (one of the ten promised Paradise). The term "Hudaafah" was used collectively to refer to the Prophet's companions, emphasizing their role as guides and helpers in spreading the message of Islam. In Islamic history and literature, the term has been used to emphasize the importance of community and guidance in religious beliefs and practices.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name "Hudaafah" represents the idea of being a compaion or guide to others on their spiritual journey towards God. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom from spiritual mentors and elders, and supporting and guiding one another in the pursuit of a closer relationship with God. The name also emphasizes the importance of being a positive influence on those around us, and using our knowledge and experiences to help others navigate the challenges of life and find their way towards greater spiritual growth.
